representativeSnapshot.kind: isolated Supabase target with an auth user and deterministic MFA issue, attempt, replay, expiry, revocation, and cleanup fixtures

rowCountQueries: Confirm public.mfa_verification_codes does not already exist or record its schema before apply

Inspect existing function signatures named issue_mfa_verification_code, begin_mfa_verification_attempt, finish_mfa_verification_attempt, revoke_mfa_verification_code, and cleanup_expired_mfa_verification_codes
Record anon, authenticated, and service_role table/function privileges before apply
preflight.expectedAffectedRows: No existing rows; the migration creates an additive table, indexes, and service-only atomic functions

execution.resumeStrategy: Reapply only in an isolated target when the migration history entry is absent; use a later additive forward fix after any recorded hosted apply
execution.idempotency: Table and indexes use IF NOT EXISTS; functions use CREATE OR REPLACE; ACL statements are deterministic

quarantine.strategy: No legacy verification-code rows exist because the previous implementation used process memory

constraints: Verification codes reference auth.users with cascade deletion and accept only sms_setup or sms_login kinds
Only bcrypt cost-12 hashes are accepted and expiry must follow issuance
Consumed and revoked terminal states cannot both be set
indexes: User/kind/latest-issued lookup for resend and issue-window limits
constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: Run supabase/tests/intg003_mfa_verification_code_security.sql, then prove deterministic issue cooldown/window limits, user scoping, three-attempt lockout, one-time consumption, replay rejection, expiry, revocation, and cleanup retention in isolated staging

recovery.rollback: Disable SMS MFA issue and verification paths and retain the table for forensic/replay evidence; do not restore the process-memory fallback
recovery.forwardFix: Correct schema, ACLs, or functions through a later reviewed additive migration and rerun the focused repository plus isolated database fixtures

queries: Verify pg_class.relrowsecurity is true and pg_policies has no client-access policy for public.mfa_verification_codes
Verify only service_role has table DML and function EXECUTE privileges
